why: Two things move on their own. The small inner square sits top-left in figures 1 and 2, then bottom-right in figures 3 and 4, so it returns to top-left. The small circle on the outer frame goes top-left, top-right, top-right, bottom-right (it moves, then stays), so it stays at bottom-right. Only option 1 has both.
trick: Follow each small object separately, one at a time. Look for a 'move, stay, move, stay' rhythm and extend it by one step.
note: Medium square position varies slightly between figures and is treated as noise; small square and circle carry the rule.
